method.title: One loop, three ways of thinking.

items.label: INPUT / 01
items.title: Sense
items.description: Start with the messy world: camera frames, sensors, radio links, and the signal underneath the noise.

items.label: LOGIC / 02
items.title: Decide
items.description: Turn inputs into useful choices with models, firmware, control logic, and repeated testing.

items.label: OUTPUT / 03
items.title: Act
items.description: Close the loop in the physical world — on a motor, in a flight controller, or inside an interaction.

paragraphs: I'm most interested in the moment software meets physics: when a control loop steadies a drone, a sensor becomes useful data, or a vision model finds structure in a frame.
This site is my field log for the things I'm learning, breaking, rebuilding, and eventually getting to work.
